name: useMemory
summary: System RAM, this app's heaps, and how close the system is to killing you.
plain: Shows how much memory the phone has left and how much this app is holding. The important field is isLowMemory: when it turns true, Android is close to killing background apps and you should release caches.
description: System totals come from ActivityManager.getMemoryInfo, polled every two seconds: total RAM, available RAM, the low-memory threshold and the kernel's own low-memory flag. App figures come from Runtime for the Java heap and Debug.getNativeHeapAllocatedSize for the native heap, which is where Hermes, decoded images and JSI allocations live. purgeCaches requests a garbage collection and re-reads; it does not claim to free system RAM, because an app cannot do that.

returns.name: totalRAMMB
returns.desc: Physical RAM the system reports, about 11,647 MB on a 12 GB device.

returns.name: freeRAMMB
returns.desc: Memory currently available to start new work.

returns.name: usedRAMMB
returns.desc: Total minus available. Includes reclaimable caches, so it reads higher than you might expect.

returns.name: isLowMemory
returns.desc: Kernel low-memory flag. When true, free buffers now.

returns.name: lowMemoryThresholdMB
returns.desc: The level at which the system starts killing background processes.

returns.name: appJavaHeapMB
returns.desc: This app's Java heap in use.

returns.name: appJavaHeapMaxMB
returns.desc: Ceiling for that heap. Crossing it throws OutOfMemoryError.

returns.name: appNativeHeapMB
returns.desc: Native allocations: the JS engine, decoded bitmaps, native modules.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: purgeCaches()
actions.desc: Requests a garbage collection and re-reads the numbers. Advisory only; the runtime decides when to collect, and it can never free system RAM.
actions.output: Returns nothing. The refreshed reading lands in the hook fields, and the amount reclaimed is logged as freedMB.

agentNote: React to isLowMemory by dropping image buffers before starting large multimodal payloads. Do not treat usedRAMMB as a leak signal; it includes reclaimable cache.
